name: Light-guide entrance coupling

original_specification.name: Light-guide entrance coupling
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for light pipes and edge-lit guides.
original_specification.sources: Small rectangular area at guide entrance
original_specification.geometry: Finite source aligned to existing guide aperture with explicit gap
original_specification.contribution_policy: One emitter, reference contribution; no emissive guide exit
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Fixture reference position is illustrative; bind the aperture and calibrate real output before optical/photometric use.
